info.name: Noyo Carrier Carrier Mapped Field Connection Eligibility API

params.name: group_id
params.description: The ID of the group to check eligibility for

params.name: carrier_id
params.description: Optional carrier ID to filter results for a specific carrier

items.docs:
Returns connection eligibility information for a group. If a carrier_id is provided,
returns eligibility information for that specific carrier. Otherwise, returns
eligibility information for all carriers for the given group.
